manifest.creator: PatchCraft
manifest.description: Soft playable keys and pad samples with clean mapping, gentle tape motion, and export-ready macro controls.

parameters.name: Delay Time
parameters.enableHint: Raise Delay Mix above zero to hear delay time changes.

parameters.name: Delay Feedback
parameters.enableHint: Raise Delay Mix above zero to hear feedback changes.

parameters.name: Sample Pitch
parameters.enableHint: MIDI Learn this to bend sample playback independently from the keyboard note.

parameters.name: Sample Start
parameters.enableHint: Map or import samples first. MIDI Learn this parameter to scrub the playback start point.

parameters.name: Sample Length
parameters.enableHint: Map or import samples first. Shorter values turn MIDI notes into chops/slices.

parameters.name: Sample Slice
parameters.enableHint: Raise Sample Slice Count above 1, then MIDI Learn this to trigger different sample regions.

parameters.name: Glitch Chance
parameters.enableHint: Map or import samples first. Raises the chance that incoming notes jump to a chopped slice.

parameters.name: Slice Count
parameters.enableHint: Set how many equal regions each mapped sample is divided into for MIDI-driven chopping.

parameters.name: Sample Reverse
parameters.enableHint: MIDI Learn this as a switch to reverse sample playback for the next triggered notes.

parameters.name: Glitch Grid
parameters.enableHint: Set the slice grid used by Glitch Chance. Higher values create tighter stutters.
